CHENG Jun，HAN Yixuan，WANG Long，ZHANG Guanjun，ZHAO Dan（Department of Pharmacy，the Third People’s Hospital Bengbu City ,Anhui Province，Bengbu 233000，China） ABSTRACT Objective To analyze adverse reactions(ADRs) associated with drug interactions of epidermal growth factor receptor tyrosine kinase inhibitor (EGFR-TKI), and promote safe drug use. Methods The case reports of ADRs caused by adverse reactions associated with drug-drug interaction of EGFR-TKI from the databases of CNKI, VIP, Wanfang and PubMed, and the literature was analyzed.. Results A total of 13 reports involving 13 patients of ADRs associated with drug-drug interaction of EGFR-TKI. Of all the 13 patients，4 were male and 9 were female with age from 35 to 79 years and the average age was 56 years. 13 cases of adverse ADRs associated with drug-drug interaction of first generation EGFR-TKI included gefitinib （ n=6 ） ,erlotinib （n=6）,icotinib（n=1）.There were many types of drugs that interact with EGFR-TKI, among which anticoagulant drugs ranked first (n=6). Adverse reactions involved multiple organs/systems such as the blood system, nervous system, urinary system, liver and gallbladder system, skin and accessory system, etc. Conclusion Clinicians and pharmacist should be aware of this clinically significant drug-drug interaction of EGFR-TKI and avoid the combined use．It is necessary to strengthen monitoring and intervention to reduce and avoid the risk of medication. KEYWORDS Epidermal growth factor receptor tyrosine kinase inhibitor;
